notes.title: Bring the Outdoors Inside!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34562653/d022f1861ce73b63f7d7858674dbf1c1404cfc11.jpg[/img]

We know you are all cooped up indoors these days, and maybe you're feeling a bit of cabin fever right about now? We are all dealing with it, and so the Walden team thought thought a walk in our virtual Walden Woods might be just what you and your family need for a peaceful afternoon stuck at home.

So, as a response to Coronavirus cabin fever, we've deeply discounted [i]Walden, a game[/i] for as long as we are able. The game will be 75% off through April 7th!  ːsteamhappyː 

We hope that this peaceful experience will help you take your mind off of everything that is going on in our world right now. Now more than ever, it's important to be mindful of our emotional health. So stay safe, stay indoors, wash your hands often, and take a wander through the woods of Walden Pond!!

With all our best wishes from the Walden team at USC Game Innovation Lab :)

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Wanderers Edition
notes.notes:
Sometimes you don’t know what you need until you have it. Lately it turns out I’ve needed a lot of soothing, which is fortunate because this week’s selection of the best indie games on Steam ranks highly on the alleviometer. We’ve the usual variety you’ve surely come to expect, and a bit less of the drama and thrills than average.

It is time, once more, for some long overdue Unknown Pleasures.

Chilling out, maxing and relaxing all cool this week: plague doctors, Arabian cyberpunks, and… underground goddamn monsters.

notes.title: Walden, a game coming to Steam!
notes.notes: We've had a lot of requests to bring Walden, a game to Steam and we were listening! This award-winning game now includes Steam Achievements. If you've always wanted to take some time out from the hustle of daily life and live a life of "simplicity" this the game for you. Play as Henry David Thoreau and live simply in nature in this 6 hour, open world experience.
